art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult holds a small closed backpack with both hands in a modest hip hinge, knees softly bent and back comfortably long. Capture the backpack drawn toward the lower ribs, elbows near the torso and shoulders away from the ears. The bag looks lightly filled rather than heavy, with no dangling straps near the feet. A plain room, rolled mat, and low daylight create a practical home-conditioning scene. Use opaque gouache, broad matte strokes, simplified architectural planes, and an airy ochre, teal, and cream palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
